name: Rio Tinto Group
content: Rio Tinto Group is a leading global mining and metals company that focuses on finding, mining, and processing the Earth's mineral resources. The company operates in approximately 35 countries and is primarily involved in the production of iron ore, aluminum, copper, and lithium. Rio Tinto is committed to providing the materials essential to human progress, including those necessary for the global transition to a low-carbon economy. With a history spanning over 150 years, the company maintains a diverse portfolio of world-class assets and is a major supplier to global industrial markets.

tabs.label: Management
tabs.content:
Officers

Jakob Stausholm(Date: 2021 January)

Chief Executive

Jakob joined Rio Tinto in 2018 as Chief Financial Officer and became Chief Executive in January 2021. He has over 20 years of experience in senior finance and strategy roles at Shell and Maersk.

Peter Cunningham(Date: 2021 June)

Chief Financial Officer

Peter was appointed Chief Financial Officer in 2021. He has been with Rio Tinto for 30 years in various senior financial and commercial roles across the Group.

Bold Baatar(Date: 2024 September)

Chief Commercial Officer

Bold joined Rio Tinto in 2013 and was appointed Chief Commercial Officer in 2024. He previously served as Chief Executive Copper.

Directors

Dominic Barton(Date: 2022 May)

Chairman

Dominic was appointed Chairman in 2022. He was previously the Global Managing Partner of McKinsey & Company and served as Canada's Ambassador to China.

Simon McKeon(Date: 2019 January)

Senior Independent Director

Simon is a Non-executive Director and Senior Independent Director. He has extensive experience in the financial services sector and was previously Executive Chairman of Macquarie Group's Victorian office.

Dean Dalla Valle(Date: 2022 June)

Independent Non-executive Director

Dean joined the Board in 2022. He has 40 years of experience in the resources sector, including senior roles at BHP and as CEO of Pacific National.
